proposition: The documentary record supports continuity of a unitary hotel-operation architecture articulated through CEXP from the 2008 reorganisation into the 2018 window, while ownership, CEXP membership, direct operation and Owners' Community authority remain distinct and source-specific.
cautions: Do not equate Owners' Community with CEXP.
Do not state that every owner automatically joined CEXP.
Do not state that CEXP physically operated every property without interruption.
Do not compress the Monte Lanza/Multimatrix transaction, CEXP constitution and Montelanza-to-CEXP exploitation cession into one legal act.
Direct operators/managers may differ from the exploitation-title/governance layer.

public_sources.point: Some owners recorded that they did not wish to integrate into CEXP and proposed individual leases.
Distinct CEXP meeting recites 29-Apr-2008 constitutive session and governance under CEXP statutes.
Owners' Community minutes recite one-unit tourist operation and Montelanza-to-CEXP continuity; this is the source's assertion, not an independent judgment.

controlled_sources.point: Controlled primary scan located; no public source bytes added by this release.
Contemporaneous Gil Marer declaration describes CEXP as current exploitation-holder/operator with guests and staff; party declaration, not independent adjudication.
Contemporaneous professional analysis treats unitary exploitation as live and minority withdrawal as an obstacle; report remains subject to its publication controls.
